# P40W3B-N09 Coupling Energy Contract — Verification Report

## 1. Case Introduction
Multi-solver coupling energy-conservation contract covering three partitioned couplings:
- (a) LBM<->FEM conjugate heat transfer (2D cavity, D2Q9 passive-scalar + Q4 conduction)
- (b) FEM<->DEM contact (floating plate impacted by two DEM discs, Newton's third law)
- (c) LBM<->FEM<->DEM three-field energy chain

## 2. Method
- Runtime ledgers with double-entry energy/momentum books
- Interface reconstruction: ZOH (1st), linear (2nd), quadratic (3rd) order
- Sub-cycling ratios r = 1, 2, 4, 8
- Falsification arm: independent-flux control for each coupling
- 48 total runs (4 ratios × 3 schemes × 3 couplings + 4×3 controls)

## 3. Results
| Criterion | Required | Actual | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| thermal_conservation_residual | < 1e-12 | 7.57e-14 | PASS |
| thermal_profile_accuracy | < 0.03 | 0.0186 | PASS |
| thermal_falsification_ratio | > 1e3 | 1.414e+12 | PASS |
| mechanical_momentum_conservation | < 1e-10 | 1.643e-14 | PASS |
| mechanical_energy_convergence | drift(r=8) < 0.05 | 0.0168 | PASS |
| three_field_energy_chain | < 1e-3 | 1.024e-06 | PASS |
| interpolation_order_scan | 1.0/2.0/3.0 ±0.3 | 0.998/1.968/2.815 | PASS |
| plate_first_frequency | < 0.03 | 0.0025 | PASS |
| matrix_completeness | 48 | 48 | PASS |

**Overall verdict: REAL** (all 14 criteria PASS)
